description: Cut this app off from your line for good: its key stops working at once, and nothing can use the number again. Use it ONLY when your human asks you directly, for example if they think the app or the line leaked. To keep the number in another app, use move_line instead.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: disconnect_line
title: Disconnect your line
